Bloomerang’s main **limitations** in the sources provided are that some features are plan- or package-dependent, and a few donation-form options are mutually exclusive or unsupported in specific contexts.[1][2]

Commonly documented limitations include:

- **Pricing scales by records/contacts**, so costs rise as your database grows, even though unlimited users are included.[1]
- **Multi-Restriction Giving is not compatible with Smart Amounts**; you must use one or the other on a donation form.[2]
- **Kiosks do not support donor-written sub-restrictions**.[2]
- **Multi-Restriction Giving amounts and sub-restrictions are collapsed by default** until a donor selects a restriction, unless you change the display setting.[2]
- **Some display options depend on your Bloomerang Fundraising package**, so not every account will see the same form-setting choices.[2]
- A user-reported limitation is that **setting an online form to default to a recurring gift was not possible at the time of that review**.[4]

If you want, I can also give you a more practical breakdown of Bloomerang’s limitations by category, such as **CRM**, **donation forms**, **reporting**, **integrations**, or **pricing**.
